title: Empty-the-Fridge Frittata
ingredients: 1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
steps: Fry onion, pepper and tomatoes in cooking spray for 7 minutes until softened. Remove from heat; stir in spinach to wilt. Season.
Line a 30 × 20cm roasting tin with parchment; spread cooked vegetables in.
Whisk eggs and milk; stir in half the cheese. Pour over vegetables; sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake 20 minutes until light golden brown on top and set in the middle.
notes: Adapt with whatever you have. Veg needing more cooking (mushrooms, leeks, courgettes, broccoli) should be fried first. Quick-cook veg (green beans, peas, asparagus) can go straight in with the egg mixture. Try different cheeses — feta, goat's cheese, mozzarella or Parmesan.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
